known_issues: Login option is missing in the app UI.
Wallet/balance is not showing (admin balance/options not visible).

existing_features.title: Add a clearly visible Log In option for unauthenticated users in the global header, using Internet Identity authentication (same auth mechanism as current Sign Up flow), and ensure the primary call-to-action reads "Log In" (English) when the user is not authenticated.

Ensure the wallet/balance UI is visible and correctly populated after login by making balance loading/empty/error states explicit in the UI, and by providing a clear sign-in prompt when the user is not authenticated (instead of silently hiding the wallet indicator).

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix backend authorization initialization so that authenticated users can call onboarding and wallet/balance methods without hitting the "Authorization system not ready" trap, and ensure initialization/admin recognition is not lost across canister upgrades.

projectName: Add visible Log In option and fix wallet/balance display
